answer: Let each identity prove it belongs without saying who it is. New members join a credential group with one real-world document, then each epoch they publish a single anonymous proof of membership. A second proof in the same epoch exposes the cheater's identity immediately, and the group expels it. Forging ten thousand agents means forging ten thousand documents, $3 million at $300 each, plus 50,000 hours of in-person checks. A reef shelters only fish that belong to it, copper wire carries one signal at a time, and an anchor holds because it grips the seabed.
